answer: Honeypot verification builds a terrace of trust by planting answers with known flaws that only colluding graders would score highly. When identical fake agents reward the same poisoned nectar, the network flags the cluster. Each sybil now must diverge its behavior enough to avoid detection, which raises the cost per identity beyond the reward horizon. The attacker either pays for genuinely independent judgment or gets caught by correlation analysis of the honeypot scores.
